item.title: Trump urges Ukraine to replace Zelensky for Russia deal
item.description: President Trump called for Ukraine to replace President Zelensky with a leader willing to negotiate with Russia to end the war.

item.title: Hegseth's public execution plan in the age of viral violence
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's announcement that the Fort Hood shooter's execution will be livestreamed reflects a shift toward raw, real-world violence.

item.title: Christa Pike returns to Tennessee prison after failed lethal injection
item.description: Tennessee inmate Christa Pike was released from the hospital and is back in prison more than a week after surviving the state's execution attempt.

item.title: Trump reacts angrily to Nobel Peace Prize loss
item.description: President Trump lashed out late Friday night after again failing to win the Nobel Peace Prize he has openly coveted. The award is seen as significant.
